_what: raw reader effect, BOTH ARMS RE-RUN IN ONE SESSION. Replaces the published cross-session figure for this contrast.
_n_matched_UNIT: REPLICATE ROWS, not cells. The 550 are 275 cells x 2 replicates; the join key includes replicate_id. Averaging replicates within a cell first gives n=275 cells over 123 tasks and the IDENTICAL point estimate and interval, because the bootstrap resamples by TASK and both replicates of a cell always travel together. Quote 275 cells / 550 replicate rows -- never '550 cells'.
